title: Khảo sát trùng từ điển trên VPS
scope: VPS PostgreSQL langoo and unauthenticated loopback dictionary API; read-only
method_notes: Counts are exact within each named snapshot. Main and follow-up snapshots differ. API probes are outside DB snapshot.
Lexical key = language_id, lemma, pos, reading. No normalization or identity inference.
Equal definition, first/last gloss difference and shared concept are separate evidence sets; do not sum them as duplicate counts.
WordNet membership counts can overlap across concepts; they are not counts of deletable sense IDs.
Gloss order alone does not prove a hierarchy. All first/last statistics are candidates for source projection review.
VPS HEAD is not the runtime source baseline: three dictionary source files have uncommitted changes.
Final exact_core_totals is a third read-only snapshot; lexeme/sense totals equal the source-group sums of the first snapshot. Later counts do not prove unchanged content hashes.

runtime.notes: Source and compiled dist contain same hotfix logic; no app restart or deployment performed by audit.
